reason: Copilot Money is a ~25-29 person consumer (B2C) personal-finance app on a single $6M Series A from Mar 2024, NYC + Santiago, with a sitting CTO (Gabriel Dieguez Franzani) and an ex-Google engineer founder-CEO; all three live postings (Senior Web, Senior Backend, Senior Fullstack) are ordinary IC product-engineer hires with no leadership gap, no post-acquisition collision, and no cloud-cost or reliability confession, and the one platform-flavored line ('we need robust backend APIs and infrastructure that can scale efficiently across platforms') describes a multiplatform expansion that already shipped (web launched Dec 2025) - a generic 'they hire engineers' match in the wrong vertical for a fractional CTO who sells B2B/PE-backed engineering-as-growth-constraint turnarounds and explicitly positions as not a consumer-app builder.
